hints.title: Maximized Bit Mask Target
hints.text: The optimal value of k sets all lower maximumBit bits of the exclusive-or sum to 1.

hints.title: Complement Mask Computation
hints.text: Let maxMask = (1 << maximumBit) - 1; then optimal k equals current prefix exclusive-or sum bitwise inverted with maxMask.

hints.title: Prefix Reduction by Popping
hints.text: Remove the last element of the prefix by applying exclusive-or with that element at each query step.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing prefix exclusive-or from scratch for each query takes O(n^2) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Rolling prefix exclusive-or allows answering each query and popping elements in O(1) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate observes that optimal k = (xor_sum ^ ((1 << maximumBit) - 1)).
